Anime2Realsim__H3.safetensors.title: Anime to Realism · H3 Ref2VA

usage: Provide the anime reference in a Ref2VA workflow. Describe the scene and whether you want natural photography, cosplay photography, or a cinematic appearance.

LumiReal

stacking: No universal stacking order is specified for this file. Keep a working base configuration, add one compatible adapter at a time, and compare the same seed. Strengths are separate for each LoRA; stacking several can compete. Follow any specific pairing documented above.

H3-Person-Remover-V1.safetensors.title: Person Remover V1

H3-Person-Remover-V1.safetensors.trigger: Use a removal instruction describing the green-masked person; no separate magic token is published.
usage: The author workflow requires a source clip, a clean first-frame background, and a tracked green mask. Use its aligned-guide workflow; simply selecting the LoRA does not create these inputs.
settings: Author starting point: strength 1, 12 steps, er_sde / simple, CFG 1; source at 24 fps with dimensions divisible by 32.
